text: ana: Hey folks — putting up a small iteration of the notification preview for SLO thresholds. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/ui/preview.png. Main question: should channels in the preview be stacked vertically (one-per-line) or compact chips in a single row? Also how should suppression badges read when multiple suppressions apply? Example: 'muted until 12:00', 'silenced by schedule'. Thoughts? :thinking: sam: I lean stacked when there are 3+ channels. Chips are fine for 1-2. Could do responsive switch (chips -> stacked) depending on available width. :+1: priya: Accessibility nit: chips in a single row can be tricky for keyboard users if they overflow — need clear focus states and an `aria-label` like `notification channel: PagerDuty, selected`. Also check color contrast on the suppression pill (current yellow variant is failing AA). matt: Microcopy thought — 'silenced by schedule' is verbose in a tight preview. Suggest a short summary line like `Suppressed · schedule` with the full reason in a tooltip/announce. jordan: Preference: stacked in the preview pane so routing order is visible. Also question: how do we represent fallback/canary routing? Inline text `fallback: regional` or an icon? ana: (typo fix) ana: good points all. Plan: responsive approach — chips for 1-2 channels, stacked for 3+. For suppression copy try `Suppressed · schedule` in the UI and full text in a hover/accessible expansion. @sam can you confirm the aria wording strategy? sam: yep. Proposal: update preview with `aria-live="polite"` for dynamic changes, and for pills use `role="status"` + descriptive `aria-label`. Quick example: `Suppressed · schedule`. Also ensure keyboard focus lands on the badge to read full content. design-bot: Updated Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxx. New frame: notification-preview/v3. ana: (again) ana: thanks — actionable follow-ups: @priya to draft a11y checklist for preview (contrast, focus, screen reader text), @matt to write 3 microcopy variants (short, medium, verbose), @sam to prototype the `aria` pattern and a responsive layout demo. Sync Thursday 10:00 AM to review. :calendar: sam: :thumbsup: priya: will do, adding notes to the design doc now. matt: I'll put the copy in the doc and include edge-case examples (multiple suppressions, overlapping schedules). jordan: thanks — I'll validate routing order visuals against the live data constraints and post any perf concerns.
